(b) You could spend the afternoon wandering through town until you find a café or park bench to relax on, maybe bringing along a book or just people-watching. It’s a simple, low-key way to unwind anywhere.
(c) Why not head to your local city library and lose yourself among the shelves, or settle into a reading corner with something you’ve been meaning to explore? It’s an easy way to enjoy a calm, low-key afternoon that keeps you away from the noise of crowded festivals.
